[EN] Between what they steal from our wagons and what they grow on those farms, those Heavens Fall folks eat pretty well! They sing thanks for their bounty every mealtime.

Me, I haven't had more than trail rations! Not fair at all.

I want you to sneak onto that farm and swipe their harvest. Let them know what it's been like for us!
[ES] ¡Entre lo que roban de nuestras carretas y lo que cultivan en esas granjas, esa gente de Heavens Fall come bastante bien! Cantan agradeciendo por su abundancia en cada comida.

¡Yo, no he tenido más que raciones de marcha! Nada justo.

[EN] Roots and berries? Dried-out berries? Bwaha!

This is what they've been singin' praises over? Even crazier than I thought!
[ES] ¿Raíces y bayas? ¿Bayas secas? ¡Bwaha!

¿Esto es por lo que han estado cantando alabanzas? ¡Más loco de lo que pensaba!

[EN] Get out there and steal me some fruit!
[ES] ¡Sal ahí fuera y róbame algo de fruta!
